annotator.notes: Student initially confuses circular shifting with simple string reversal and struggles with slicing indices. Tutor corrects the logic and guides them to the correct slicing formula.

task_context.problem_statement:
def circular_shift(x, shift):
    """Circular shift the digits of the integer x, shift the digits right by shift
    and return the result as a string.
    If shift > number of digits, return digits reversed.
    >>> circular_shift(12, 1)
    "21"
    >>> circular_shift(12, 2)
    "12"
    """
